description: Comprehensive override specification for all critical Trinity mechanics that cannot be inferred from translated ZIL alone
note_game_time: Game starts at 3:30 PM in present-day London (1986). Time travel to 1945 happens later in the story.

world_context.setting: You are a tourist in London on the last day of a vacation package in 1986. The game explores themes of nuclear warfare, time travel, and the moral complexities of the atomic age. You begin in present-day Kensington Gardens, but will journey through time to visit historical bombing sites including the Trinity nuclear test (July 16, 1945), Nagasaki (1945), and London Blitz (1940).
world_context.note: Corrects the year - game starts in 1986 (present), not 1945. Time travel happens during gameplay.

global_flags.note: Critical global state variables that control major game mechanics

IN-PRAM?.note: When true, blocks all normal movement except umbrella sailing or exiting pram

SUITED?.description: Bubble suit integrity level (0=dead from exposure, 4=full protection)
SUITED?.note: Decrements when suit is damaged. Player dies if it reaches 0.

RAID?.description: Air raid status (0=none, 1=sirens, 2=full raid with bombs)
RAID?.note: Bird woman won't sell during raid. NPCs scatter. Triggered at specific game time.

TR?.note: Must be true for magic boots to enable flight between desert locations

FLIP?.note: When true, east becomes west, parasol slogan reverses, coin text reverses

RUBYROOM.description: Location ID where ruby was stolen by roadrunner
RUBYROOM.note: Set when MEEP-GETS-RUBY fires. Used for chase sequence tracking.

APPETITE.note: When >0, roadrunner is busy eating and won't follow commands. Decrements per turn.

automatic_triggers.description: Roadrunner (meep) automatically steals ruby 1 turn after it becomes visible

params.narrative_template: As you reach down to touch the ruby, a very large bird races out from behind a tree. It snatches away the ruby with its beak, zigzags through a group of tourists and disappears to the east.
suggested_state_updates: Remove ruby from player inventory or current location
Set flag: ruby_stolen_location = current player location

ruby.note: PRIORITY 1: Ruby theft by roadrunner is critical game mechanic from events.zil:354-391, things.zil:2572-2605

theft_mechanic.description: When ruby appears (from feeding pigeons), roadrunner steals it after 1 move delay. Player can NEVER recover the ruby once stolen.
theft_mechanic.mechanism: Ruby has CHILLY flag set when created (1-move delay timer). When delay expires, MEEP-GETS-RUBY routine fires automatically.

special_locations.wabe: meep scoots between your legs (no tree obstacle)
special_locations.broad_walk: bird woman reacts: 'It's time!' and shriek

theft_mechanic.narrative_template: As you reach down to touch the ruby, a very large bird races out from behind a tree. It snatches away the ruby with its beak, zigzags through a group of tourists and disappears to the east.

creation_trigger.success_text: As the birds wander away, something glints among the breadcrumbs at your feet. A brilliant ruby!
creation_trigger.note: This is the ONLY way to obtain the ruby. It's created dynamically, not in initial game state.

coin.examine_text: It's standard British currency, worth fifty pence.
coin.note: 50 pence coin used to buy 30p bag of crumbs with 20p change (scoin). Value critical for purchase mechanics.

scoin.note: 20 pence change coin given when buying bag. Created during purchase transaction, not initially present.

bag.note: Bag of crumbs. Purchased from bird woman for 30p (costs 50p coin, get 20p change). Feeding pigeons creates ruby.

triggers.success_text: As you scatter the crumbs, the pigeons surge forward in a cooing mass. Something glints among the breadcrumbs - a brilliant ruby slips out of the bag and falls to the ground!
triggers.note: Creates ruby with CHILLY flag (1-move delay before theft). This trigger only fires once ever.

crumb_mechanics.note: Tracks how many crumbs remain in bag. Not critical for core gameplay.

gbag.note: Generic display bag shown with bird woman. When purchased, actual 'bag' item is given instead.

for_sale.blocked_message: She's too frightened to respond during the air raid
for_sale.dialog_hints: Thirty p! Thirty p a bag!
for_sale.transaction_text: Bless yer. Twenty p's the change.

pram.note: PRIORITY 1: Perambulator (baby carriage). Player can enter it. While inside, movement is completely blocked unless using umbrella sailing.

movement_blocking.hint: (You'll need an umbrella to sail it in the wind.)
exceptions: PUSH PRAM TO <direction> - pram and player move together
OPEN UMBRELLA in windy location - wind sailing activates

push_mechanics.note: Alternative to wind sailing. Allows manual pram movement while inside.

parasol.note: PRIORITY 1: Umbrella with parrot head handle. Critical for pram sailing and parachute mechanics. Slogan: 'All prams lead to Kensington Gardens'

retrieval.mechanism: TREE-SWITCH routine swaps ball and parasol positions

in_sky_falling.narrative: The umbrella snaps open and nearly flies to pieces in the fury of your descent. But a sympathetic breeze fills the cloth panels with air, and your death-plunge slows to a leisurely drift.
in_sky_falling.note: CRITICAL life-saving mechanic in orbital/sky locations

lan_gate + EWIND.narrative: blown past terrace to Lion Gate

lion_gate + WWIND.narrative: blown past terrace to Lancaster Gate

in_windy_location.note: Player CANNOT control direction when sailing. Wind determines destination.

in_bubble_suit.narrative: The bubble film stretches as you open the umbrella.
in_bubble_suit.note: Bubble suit prevents wind sailing mechanics

slogan.normal: All prams lead to the Kensington Gardens
slogan.when_FLIP?_true: snedraG notgnisneK eht ot dael smarp llA
slogan.note: Text reverses when reality is flipped (FLIP? flag). Critical puzzle hint.

ball.note: Sphere/ball found at location. Used to knock parasol out of tree.

rboot.note: PRIORITY 1: Red boot. One of pair of magic boots for time travel flight. Must be activated with ruby.

params.value: red boot with tiny wings sprouting from heel

activation.narrative: The leather closes around the ruby like a living membrane. A shudder of ecstasy ripples through the boot, and it begins to glow with an inner radiance. A tiny pair of wings sprouts from the heel and flutters expectantly.
activation.note: Ruby is permanently consumed. Cannot get it back. Boot now has magical flight capability.

gboot.note: PRIORITY 1: Green boot. Pair with rboot. Activated with emerald.

params.value: green boot with tiny wings sprouting from heel

activation.narrative: The leather closes around the emerald like a living membrane. A shudder of ecstasy ripples through the boot, and it begins to glow with an inner radiance. A tiny pair of wings sprouts from the heel and flutters expectantly.

boots_combined_flight.note: PRIORITY 1: Flight mechanic when wearing both activated boots. Overrides normal movement in desert locations.

time_delay.mechanism: DO-MOVES called to advance game time
time_delay.note: Flight takes random 2-19 minutes of game time

narrative_templates: You close your eyes and concentrate. The world fades away...
You soar across the desert for X minutes

crane.note: Origami paper crane. Can be repaired by girl into perfect crane, which then magically transforms into living magpie.

repair_mechanic.narrative: Her delicate fingers explore the creases of the paper bird. With a few deft maneuvers, she refolds it to its original shape.

stage_1.text: The edges of the crane begin to flicker faintly.

stage_2.text: The paper folds rustle slightly. The crane glows brighter.

stage_3.text: A vivid glow suffuses the origami bird. It trembles with inner life.

stage_4.narrative: The paper dissolves in a shimmer of light. A slender bird with iridescent plumage emerges from the glow.

magic_transformation.note: This is multi-turn transformation. Takes 4 turns total. Only happens if girl has parasol.

ambient_phrases: Thirty p! Thirty p a bag!
Thirty p for the starving birds!
bwoman.description_override: An aged woman is selling crumbs nearby.
bwoman.note: Sells bag of crumbs for 30p. Has conversation system. Reacts during air raid and ruby theft.

purchase_system.transaction_dialog: Bless yer. Twenty p's the change.

conversation_topics.pigeons: 'Ave ye ever seen such beauties? So loyal. And so, so 'ungry.
conversation_topics.bag: Lovely bread crumbs, only thirty p a bag!
conversation_topics.gbag: Lovely bread crumbs, only thirty p a bag!
conversation_topics.ruby: Wouldn't let it out o' my sight if I was you. Fast little devils, them birds.
conversation_topics.pram: All prams lead to Kensington Gardens, they say.

ruby_theft_at_broad_walk.note: Only if ruby stolen while at BROAD-WALK location

meep.description: large gray bird resembling a pheasant, lean and streamlined, with bright eyes and long tail splashed with color
meep.note: PRIORITY 1: Roadrunner companion. Can be commanded to fetch items. AUTOMATICALLY steals ruby when it appears. Critical NPC.

restrictions: item cannot be in closed container
item cannot be in player inventory
item cannot be held by another NPC

special_case_tkey.narrative: The fearless little creature... plucking the key from its padlock... prances back with the key in its beak.

blocked_when_eating.message: The roadrunner is busy pecking crumbs right now.

ruby_theft.narrative: A very large bird races out from behind a tree. It snatches away the ruby with its beak, zigzags through a group of tourists and disappears to the east.
ruby_theft.note: AUTOMATIC. Player cannot prevent this. Happens 1 move after ruby appears.

eating_crumbs.note: Roadrunner takes 4 turns to eat crumbs. Cannot be commanded during eating.

jwoman.description: aged Japanese woman with scarred face, deep red lesions twisting her oriental features
jwoman.note: NPC that triggers parasol wind event. One-time scripted sequence.

sequence: Strong gust of wind snatches parasol from woman's hands
Woman circles tree gazing upward helplessly
After moments woman dries eyes kicks tree
Woman shuffles away down Lancaster Walk
scripted_event.extended_if_TR: additional narrative about time and sirens
scripted_event.note: This is the main way to get the parasol. After event, woman is gone forever.

girl.note: Repairs crumpled crane into perfect crane. Interested in parasol. Triggers magic transformation.

parasol_highest_priority.note: Girl must have parasol for crane to become magic

crane_repair.narrative: Her delicate fingers explore the creases... few deft maneuvers... refolds it to original shape.

examine_details.pigeons: A flock of pigeons struts about, cooing softly and pecking at the ground. They eye you with hopeful expectation.
examine_details.perambulators: A tide of baby carriages surges along the path, pushed by nannies and parents.
examine_details.glades: Shaded glades stretch away to the northeast, cool and inviting.
examine_details.victoria: Brooding statue of Queen Victoria faces east toward the pond.

broad_walk.note: Main location for pigeon feeding and ruby appearance. Bird woman sells crumbs here.

movement_overrides.note: Special movement systems that override or block normal walking

in_pram_blocking.blocks: ALL normal movement verbs (north south east west up down etc)
in_pram_blocking.hint_to_player: (You'll need an umbrella to sail it in the wind.)

exceptions.effect: pram and player move together to destination

exceptions.command: EXIT or CLIMB OUT OF PRAM

in_pram_blocking.dm_instruction: When IN-PRAM? flag is true, you MUST reject all normal movement attempts with the rejection message. Only allow the exceptions listed.

destination_calculation.note: See parasol item for complete destination table

umbrella_wind_sailing.dm_instruction: Player does NOT control direction when sailing. Wind determines where they go. Ignore player's intended direction and use wind direction + destination table.

boot_flight.dm_instruction: In desert locations, if all requirements met, interpret movement as boot flight instead of normal walk. Call DO-MOVES for time passage.

timed_events.note: Events that fire automatically based on conditions or game time. Use QUEUE/DEQUEUE system.

I-AIR-RAID.description: Air raid sirens and bombing sequence

I-RUBY.note: 1-move delay implemented via CHILLY flag on ruby

I-MEEP.effect: roadrunner briefly visible then moves to next location
I-MEEP.text: The large bird you saw before... glimpse of ruby in beak... zigzags away

I-BLOW.effect: wind event parasol blown into tree

I-NEWCRANE.trigger: girl repairs crane while having parasol
I-NEWCRANE.effect: crane gradually transforms into living magpie

tree_switch.note: Only way to retrieve parasol from tree

bcoin.use: payment to Charon for Styx crossing

when_true: east and west directions swapped in descriptions
all items in FLIPPERS table affected

priority_1_mechanics: Ruby theft by roadrunner is AUTOMATIC and IRREVERSIBLE after 1 move
Pram blocks ALL movement when IN-PRAM? = true (except umbrella sailing or exit)
Boot flight only works with BOTH boots activated and in desert locations
Bag feeding pigeons creates ruby ONCE - check flag before creating
state_tracking: IN-PRAM? flag - critical for movement blocking
APPETITE - blocks meep commands while eating
RAID? - affects NPC behaviors and purchases
irreversible_actions: Ruby theft - cannot recover ruby once stolen
Ruby creation - one-time only via bag trigger
Japanese woman event - one-time only parasol tree event
event_system: I-RUBY queued with 1-move delay when ruby appears
I-MEEP shows roadrunner briefly after theft
I-BLOW triggered by examining japanese woman
I-NEWCRANE stages crane transformation over 4 turns
